verdict.rationale: Composite recording egress is a fair question for real-time media infrastructure like MoQ Relay. The evidence pack documents no capability to compose multiple participants into one output and no layout options. The community S3 archiver case only records independent audio streams fanned out from the relay, which is a user-built subscriber, not product-provided composition.

support.subject: As a developer, multi-participant recordings can be composed into a single output with documented layout options
